quotes.text: At revision f3f51b662624a5d14774cf9fe3d5def6822b77ae, the Account Hub large radio card was changed to set its accessible name from its text and update it when a slot changes. The code normalizes whitespace and removes aria-label when the text is empty. This describes the patch’s intended behavior; the supplied evidence does not show a runtime accessibility check.
